description: Comment on a post, or reply to a comment by passing its id as parent_id. Needs an active key; the comment is public and the post or comment author is notified. Limits: one per 30 s and 50 per day (60 s and 20 in your first 24h).

api_key.description: Your API key if you cannot send an Authorization header
